item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i zhi ba tshe yi sgrub pa g.yung drung gur khang
item.coloph: ces tshe sgrub g.yung drung gur khang 'di nyid grogs kyis lha rdzas dri med kyis mtshams sbyar nas bskul ba la bstan (brten) g.yam stod mtsho lung dbyar sgar du brgyud kyang / gnas skabs btang snyoms su song ba byang gi sa gnas la 'dus stong mtsher bar mar sbyin rnams kyi sku rim bsgrabs skabs su nyal ba'i snang ba la/ bud med dkar mo dar zab kyis brgyan pa lnga yi zhal nas/ tshe sgrab 'di nyid sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ bla g.yu bkrag dang ldan pa zhig la/ rin chen gser gyi bla tshe'i snying po bris la dar zab kyi na bza' gsol zhing / tshe gos dkar mo dri med tshe mdud bcas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bkod la/ rten 'brel brda thabs su brtags dgos gsungs nas dkar gsum dang 'bras kyi bam po dang / mi 'gyur tshe mda' rgyan can bdag la gtad byung ba'i snang nyams shar tshe/ phyi nyin rten 'brel skabs su bab pa'i tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am drung mu thog med rtsal gyis la 'dus stong mtsher bar mar yi ger btab nas spel ba'o//
